import z3

n = 6
target = 111

# Create variables
cells = [[z3.Int(f"c_{i}_{j}") for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]

s = z3.Solver()

# Each cell is between 1 and 36
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        s.add(cells[i][j] >= 1, cells[i][j] <= 36)

# All distinct
all_cells = [cells[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(n)]
s.add(z3.Distinct(all_cells))

# Row sums
for i in range(n):
    s.add(z3.Sum([cells[i][j] for j in range(n)]) == target)

# Column sums
for j in range(n):
    s.add(z3.Sum([cells[i][j] for i in range(n)]) == target)

# Main diagonal
s.add(z3.Sum([cells[i][i] for i in range(n)]) == target)

# Anti-diagonal
s.add(z3.Sum([cells[i][n-1-i] for i in range(n)]) == target)

print("Solving...")
result = s.check()
print(f"Result: {result}")

if result == z3.sat:
    m = s.model()
    flat = []
    for i in range(n):
        row = []
        for j in range(n):
            val = m.evaluate(cells[i][j]).as_long()
            row.append(val)
            flat.append(val)

        assert sum(flat[i*n + j] for i in range(n)) == target, f"Col {j} wrong"
    assert sum(flat[i*n + i] for i in range(n)) == target, "Main diag wrong"
    assert sum(flat[i*n + (n-1-i)] for i in range(n)) == target, "Anti diag wrong"
